class.name: GameplayDedicatedServer
class.brief_description: Headless ENet bootstrap for the gameplay session state machine.
class.description: GameplayDedicatedServer owns the GF-2 version, authentication, and join handshake. The [member authenticator] must return a Dictionary containing [code]accepted[/code] and, on success, stable [code]user_id[/code], [code]session_id[/code], and opaque [code]reconnect_token[/code]. Optional [member replication] and [member prediction] adapters share the peer while retaining their own sender, ownership, and authority validation. ENet does not encrypt these packets, so production deployments must use short-lived credentials and an appropriate secure network boundary.

method.name: begin_shutdown
method.description: Refuses new connections, drains existing peers, then stops at the deadline.

method.name: get_multiplayer_peer
method.description: Returns the owned ENet peer while running.

method.name: get_transport_peer_count
method.description: Returns the number of connected transport peers.

method.name: is_refusing_new_connections
method.description: Returns whether ENet rejects new transports.

method.name: is_shutting_down
method.description: Returns whether the server is draining.

method.name: poll
method.description: Polls ENet, dispatches handshake packets, expires sessions, and advances shutdown.

method.name: refuse_new_connections
method.description: Stops transport and gameplay admission without dropping existing peers.

method.name: start_from_command_line
method.description: Starts from explicit arguments, or OS user arguments when empty.

method.name: stop_now
method.description: Immediately closes ENet and removes all sessions.

members.member: Optional callable receiving user and session IDs and returning whether business admission succeeds.
Authentication adapter callable receiving auth and reconnect tokens.
Whether the server listener is active.
Optional RPC and property replication adapter sharing the server peer.
Optional authoritative input and prediction snapshot adapter sharing the server peer.

signal.name: server_stopped
signal.description: Emitted after the transport and sessions close.
